data.narrative: Student demonstrated exceptional architectural understanding throughout Module 01, articulating clean service boundaries for monorepos and designing a robust fail-fast configuration validator. Diagnosed the injected NaN boot error swiftly and confirmed healthy recovery with rigorous regression checks.

dimension_scores.observation: Clearly articulated the monorepo tradeoff between initial workspace overhead vs long-term multi-tenant service isolation.
dimension_scores.evidence: In a B2B SaaS, isolating background workers into apps/worker ensures CPU-heavy jobs do not block HTTP redirects, while packages/shared ensures shared validation schemas.

dimension_scores.observation: Formed a structured hypothesis, identified the fastest command to test it, and correctly interpreted the Zod error message.
dimension_scores.evidence: Diagnosed that 'received nan' indicated an empty or malformed non-numeric string in PORT, restored PORT=3000, and verified via curl.

dimension_scores.observation: Understood the critical security difference between public unauthenticated redirects and authenticated tenant management APIs.
dimension_scores.evidence: Highlighted IDOR vulnerabilities, tenant data leakage, and preventing credentials/secrets from being committed to version control.

dimension_scores.observation: Understood fail-fast validation preventing deployment poisoning and rolling deploy failures.
dimension_scores.evidence: Explained how fallback defaults cause delayed runtime crashes or port binding mismatches in container orchestrators.

dimension_scores.observation: Answers were concise, precise, and framed with practical production engineering terminology.
dimension_scores.evidence: Consistently provided commands, expected outputs, and trade-off rationales across all questions.

strengths: Strong grasp of container lifecycle, liveness vs readiness, and fail-fast startup design
Structured, disciplined debugging methodology following reproduction, diagnosis, fix, and regression verification
growth_areas: Continue applying this strict multi-tenant boundary discipline as we introduce database persistence in Module 02
data.recommendation: Maintain this high bar for evidence-based verification when evaluating relational vs document stores in Module 02.

public_evidence.student_action: Architected monorepo API service with fail-fast environment schema validation and health check route
public_evidence.technical_detail: apps/api/src/config/env.ts validates PORT with Zod before socket binding; apps/api/src/app.ts exposes GET /health
public_evidence.proof: curl -i http://localhost:3000/health returned HTTP 200 OK with {"ok": true}; PORT=invalid failed with exit code 1
public_evidence.ability: Builds resilient backend foundations with fail-fast configuration guards
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows candidate builds production-grade services that prevent misconfiguration crashes and environment drift
